plan: SEARCH r USING INDEX idx_tlog_intent_rowid (intent=? AND rowid>? AND rowid<?)
sql: SELECT r.payload_redacted,r.timestamp_ns,r.frame_id FROM transparency_log r INDEXED BY idx_tlog_intent_rowid WHERE r.rowid>?2 AND r.rowid<=?3 AND ?1 IS ?1 AND r.intent='distillate.redistill.requested' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transparency_log o INDEXED BY idx_tlog_redistill_outcome WHERE o.intent IN ('distillate.redistilled','distillate.redistill.pending') AND json_extract(CAST(o.payload_redacted AS TEXT),'$.request.redacted_distillate_frame_id')=json_extract(CAST(r.payload_redacted AS TEXT),'$.request.redacted_distillate_frame_id'))
